findings.location: Final employer evidence box near original line 399
findings.claim: Full accepted local deliveries complete in fractions of a second to about 1.34 seconds.
findings.reason: That range is the 36 fresh confirmation jobs' process-turnaround range. Load runs reach 1.362470 seconds of process turnaround and 5.510788 seconds from submission to delivery. The unqualified employer-facing statement can imply a total wait guarantee.
findings.required_change: Scope the sentence explicitly to the 36 fresh confirmation jobs and their process-launch boundary; refer queued latency separately.
findings.suggested_text: The 36 fresh confirmation jobs took 0.161–1.338 seconds from process launch through acceptance and packaging; submission-to-delivery latency for queued batches is reported separately.

findings.location: Complete cost subsection near original line 244
findings.claim: q_H and q_A are eventual acceptance fractions while t_H, h_A and u are per attempted job.
findings.reason: The wording leaves room to use final job-level acceptance after multiple retries with per-try costs. The formulas are correct only when numerator and acceptance denominator share one accounting boundary.
findings.required_change: Define q as accepted deliveries divided by attempted jobs at the declared boundary, and require retry/rework cost to be included consistently. If an attempted job includes all retries, its resource numerator must include them.
findings.suggested_text: At a common accounting boundary, q is accepted deliveries divided by attempted jobs; all resources spent on correction, retries and abandoned attempts are included. A workflow that treats an entire retry sequence as one attempted job must charge the entire sequence.

findings.claim: No newly recruited human panel is required; matched trial is described as not observed.
findings.reason: The text is substantively honest but the original requested empirical-human status should be unmistakable. A visible status label improves separation from the completed market-data analysis.
findings.recommended_change: Add: Matched empirical no-AI human comparison: NOT RUN. Market-data comparison: completed as an explicitly conditional model.

findings.location: Capacity figure caption near original line 311
findings.claim: More processes improve throughput while increasing per-job CPU and contention.
findings.reason: Higher measured per-job CPU is observed; increased contention is a plausible explanation rather than separately measured causal evidence.
findings.recommended_change: Use 'with higher measured CPU per job' or mark contention as a possible explanation.

findings.location: Economic scenarios subsection near original line 274
findings.claim: Both acceptance fractions equal one in this illustration; the companion varies them.
findings.reason: At review time the source-grounded benchmark and attention scripts present equal-acceptance thresholds; acceptance-variation output was not yet found. This may be pending in the figure/scenario build.
findings.required_change: Before final build, confirm the companion really contains the predeclared q=0.8/0.95/1 sensitivity with its script and assumptions, or revise the sentence. Do not change frozen confirmation outputs.

confirmed_boundaries: 36 fresh controlled jobs and 108 load repetitions are distinguished; no row or assertion is treated as a fresh human job.
All 36 confirmation jobs passed on the first recorded attempt; the acceptance and turnaround figures match saved analysis.
Acceptance is explicitly deterministic, role-independent technical checking; no human/client usability certification or willingness to pay is claimed.
The natural showcase is development-selected and uses public source metadata, not a live website check.
Exact-string semantics, duplicate Cartesian pairs, unshared columns and refusal limits match original source behavior.
Retained tool bytes are reused on 36 fresh jobs; no discovered algorithm, selected-only optimization, causal learning improvement or increasing improvement rate is claimed.
Full cost, setup, review, maintenance and investment allocation remain unknown; zero operational model calls are not equated with zero total cost.
Published human timings retain original tasks, populations, censorship and AI-use limits; none supplies a matched denominator.
Prestart STOP, injected clock timeout, explicit restart, local byte restoration and declared schema fallback are described at their observed scope.
Market scenarios are labeled assumptions; wages, GDP, provider revenue, customer savings and profit remain distinct.
Source inspection and unfunded drafts are distinguished from transactions; USDC and AGIALPHA routes are separated.
All 43 citation keys used in the reviewed draft exist in references.bib.
